name: BKV Corporation
description: BKV Corp is a growth-driven energy company focused on the development of natural gas-producing assets, the ownership and operation of natural gas-fired power generation assets, and selective accretive acquisitions. The company's core businesses are the production of natural gas and the generation of natural gas-fired power from its owned and operated assets, supported by a closed-loop plan, enabled by its upstream, midstream, power, and CCUS businesses.
